Lots of different chip strategy approaches that could work!

Opta match report cards for some of today's pre-season friendlies 🧵

Starting with Chelsea v Real Sociedad where Lacroix, James and Rogers got an hour each ahead of #FPL GW1👇

Gonzalo García (£6.0m) is one of the Solio model's favourite budget forward picks for the opening 6GW, marginally ahead of more popular picks like Brobbey  👇

A bit more uncertainty compared to established players like Calvert-Lewin and Brobbey, but lots of upside too!

Iliman Ndiaye (£6.0m) remains the Solio model's favourite budget #FPL midfielder pick for now, but all eyes on late transfer speculation before the window closes 👇

Pascal Groß still showing as good value, with Buendía and Tavernier in the mix as lower-owned alternatives

Updated season-long G+A spreads 👇

Quite a few new markets since last update, including Šeško, Estêvão and a punchy total for Arsenal's Tzolis.

Semenyo's assist total got re-rated with the addition of Doku's G+A markets (down 4.25 from 6 August) - seems a bit of a surprise!

Final one of the weekend - Liverpool summary from the Monaco friendly 👇

First pre-season starts for Van Dijk, Gakpo & Alisson. Isak got an hour after 45' vs Leeds, same for Wirtz and Grav. Szobo and Frimpong both ~250 mins of pre-season minutes now.

Arsenal summary from the Dortmund friendly 👇

60 mins for Gabriel (played 30' last friendly) & Calafiori (3 x 60' LB starts now), Mosquera & White 78' (both have started for 60-45-78 in pre-season). Ødegaard planned 30' sub, with Tzolis taking some set pieces 2nd half.

Man City summary from the Atlético friendly 👇

Second pre-season game with Semenyo LW, Savinho RW with Doku out. Foden, Dias and Gvardiol played full 90 - Gvardiol started LB and moved inside second half with Rico Lewis coming on. Foden and Reijnders splitting set pieces.

Man Utd summary from the PSG friendly 👇

Mbeumo started CF (5 shots, 4 on target) and took corners/FKs before Bruno's introduction. Dorgu LW and Amad RW. Early injury for Mount (who started CM) and a knock for Shaw. Youri Tielemans 6 DEFCON in a 26 minute cameo for the fans 😅

Brighton summary & starting XI average position map from their Roma friendly 👇

Minteh injury one to keep an eye on. Groß on all set pieces as expected, 45' each for Vušković and Dunk, Georginio Rutter the starting CF.
